thread:
Asha R: Quick design huddle 30m9 about the Private setup wizard network step. Main pain: failing prereq shows a huge raw dump and users don't know next steps. Can we tighten copy, add a compact checklist, and fix focus after failures?

Leo: Totally. Suggestion: replace raw dump with a single friendly line + two actions. Example copy: "Connectivity check: we couldn't reach your host." Primary: "Run quick network diagnostic" Secondary: "Contact support".

Priya: For self-serve debugging, add a collapsed checklist (DNS lookup, port open, TLS handshake). Each item tappable to expand a 1-line command and a copy button. Keep collapsed by default.

Accessibility Bot: Requirements: 1) announce failure using aria-live="assertive" 2) move focus to primary action on error 3) collapsed details must be keyboard-expandable with aria-controls/aria-expanded 4) modal trap focus if diagnostics opens.

Asha R: Also: don't render logs inline. Provide a small "Advanced details" disclosure that reveals a summary and a Download logs (.log) link. If user needs full logs, support can fetch them.

Leo: UX question: modal vs drawer for diagnostics? My vote: modal for simpler a11y semantics. It also lets us show a short pass/fail summary and a copyable test command like `nc -vz 10.0.1.5 5678`.

Priya: Copy pass for checklist item: "Port (TCP) 9  allow outbound to 5678". We'll A/B test slight variants: "allow outbound" vs "open on your firewall". Also add inline note: "You can change this later in advanced settings." to cut down tickets.

Asha R: Small UI nit: error icon color needs higher contrast at 14px. Also make sure the error pill has sufficient padding and a clear focus ring.

Accessibility Bot: Dev hints: use role="alert" for the pill, focus the primary button with element.focus(), and add aria-describedby on the button pointing to the friendly message. Ensure the disclosure toggle is a real button so it is tabbable.

Leo: Implementation note: map common codes to plain text (504 -> "Gateway timeout: port may be blocked"). Don't echo stack traces. Raw logs available as downloadable `.log` with server-side truncation.

Priya: On mobile, tooltips are fragile. Use an inline chevron that expands a small inline row instead of hover tooltips. Keep copy short for small screens.

Asha R: I'll update the Figma: compact error state, checklist collapsed view, modal spec for diagnostics, and copy variants for A/B test. Priya, can you mock the copy variants?

Priya: Yep will drop two label variants in the mock and add microcopy for the support link (prefill host+port).

Leo: I'll prototype the disclosure animation and ensure the download link opens a new tab and keyboard users get focusable link text.

Asha R: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Priya mock by EOD, Leo prototype tomorrow, I'll review accessibility notes and ship a spec. :white_check_mark:
